title: "Muras" ethnography forum - uluttuk murastyn zhany demi

blocks.text: 2025-zhyldyn 18-mayynda Bishkek mamlekettik universityinde kyrgyz ethnographyson arnalgan republicalyk dengeeldegi “Muras” forum iygiliktuu otkoruldu. Bul ish-chara uluttuk madaniyatty, tarykhy murasty zhana ethnographylyk baaluuluktardy saktoo zhana zhaiyltuu maksatyn kozdodu.
Forumdun achylyshynda BMUnun to the rector, professor Mirlan Dyldaev soz suylop, kyrgyz ethnography synyn ilimdegi zhana koomdogu maanisi tuuraluu oh bolushүp, forumdun katyshuuchularyn kuttuktady.
Ish-charaga mamlekettik zhana madaniy chөyrөnүn kөrүnүktuү өkүldөrү katyshty:

• October Kapalbaev, Kyrgyz Republic son Presidentinin Administration son sayasiy zhana ekonomikalyk izildөolөr bashkarmalygynyn nachalniginin orun basary, strategylyk plandoo zhana reformalardy taldoo bolumun baschysy;
• Soyuzbek Nadyrbekov, Madaniyat, maalymat zhana zhashtar sayasati ministerinin orun basary;
• Kurmangazy Azykbaev, Kyrgyz Republicsyn el artists.
Bakirov Bayel, Muras ethno platform son zhetekchisi.

Madaniy program alkagynda Kurmangazy Azykbaev segiz aspapta kol oinotup, katyshuuchularga zhogorku dengeelde uluttuk obondordu tartuulady. Oshondoy ele, danazaluu manaschylar el aldynda Manas aityp, kyrgyz eposunun teren philosophyson of zhan korkomduk baaluuluktaryn danazalashty. Forumdun dagy bir өzgөcho bөlүgү - kyrgyz uluttuk kiyimderinin korgozmosu boldu. Bul korgozmodo ar kyl doorlorgo tiesheluu salttuu kiimder sunushtalyp, kopchuluktun kyzyguusun zharatty. Airykcha zhashtar uluttuk kiyim madaniyaty menen zhakyndan taanyshuuga mumkunduk alyshty.

Forumdun zhurushundo katyshuuchular kyrgyz ethnography sonnyn azyrky abali, onүgүү bagyttary, oshondoy ele tarykhy murasty saktoonun zana any zhany muundarga otkөrүp beruүnun Maanisi tuuraluu keniri talkuu zhurguzushtu.

“Muras” for the forum - bul tarykh menen bugunku kundu baylanyshtyryp turgan ayantcha. Ar bir katyshuuchu bul zherden uluttuk өzdugun sezip, kyrgyz madaniyatynyn baylygyn dagı bir zholu taanyp chykty.
